learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn that every person, place, animal, and thing has a special name!
warm_up_hook: 📖 Hello little friend! Look around your room. Do you see a toy? Do you see a bed? Everything you see has a name. Let us learn about these magic naming words today!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Look at your family! You have a mother, a father, and friends. These are names of people. A doctor and a teacher are also names for people.
Where do we go to play? We go to the park! Where do we go to learn? We go to school! Park and school are names of places.
Look outside the window. Do you see a bird flying? Do you have a pet cat? Animals and birds have names too!
What do you like to play with? A toy! What do you eat? An apple! Things we use, eat, or play with are called things.

practice_quiz.question: ❓ Which of these is the name of an animal?
❓ Which of these is a name of a place?

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Naming Words Hunt!
fun_activity.instructions: Run around your house and touch 3 different things. Say their names out loud like Table, Sofa, Door! You are a naming word champion!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Everything in the whole world has a name!
⭐ Names of people, places, animals, and things are called Naming Words.
